en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone road across a low bridge with wooden railings, leading toward a tree-lined area with scattered wooden houses. A man walks on the right side of the bridge and a small cart stands on the left. Tall telegraph/telephone poles with multiple cross arms line the bridge. The words "WASA" and "Brändö bro" appear at the top of the image.
